case_title: JAGDISH & ORS. v. STATE OF UTTARANCHAL
statutory_provisions: IPC s.304B, s.498A; Dowry Prohibition Act s.3 and 4
aggravating_circumstances: Haste cremation without waiting for family of the deceased
mitigating_circumstances: Appellant-Jagdish is elderly and has no family
neutral_facts: The accused, who were in-laws of the deceased, demanded dowry and subjected the victim to harassment and cruelty. The victim was physically beaten and taken to a hospital. A compromise deed was executed, but the harassment continued. The victim was burnt to death, and the accused hurriedly cremated her without informing her family or the police. The accused were convicted of dowry death and other offences, but the conviction of one accused was modified due to his age and circumstances.
